vehicle.mass_note: Measured with setup wheel adapters, 75kg driver, 35kg fuel. Adapters cancel in ratios.

corner_weights.note: RR calculated: total - FL - FR - RL. Measured on setup patch including adapters.

vehicle.yaw_inertia_note: Estimated from Iz = m*a*b bicycle model approximation. Error ~10-20%. Replace with homologation value when available.
vehicle.steering_ratio_note: Read from steering ratio lookup table at centre wheel travel and zero steering stroke. Treated as constant at Level 1.
vehicle.cog_note: Derived from static weight distribution. a = L * rear_fraction, b = L * front_fraction.

stability_estimation._comment_yaw_stability: Module 5 estimator (modules/yaw_stability.py), after the chair performance_analysis tooling (internal). These are the values the chair pipeline actually runs (its dataclass defaults / default invocation) -- changing any of the six re-triggers classification-threshold re-derivation (WP5b(e) pattern), since thresholds are tuned to this estimator's output distribution.
stability_estimation._comment_cs_fallback: Fallback cornering stiffness references. Derived from axle normal load × C_alpha/Fz = 12 rad⁻¹ (Milliken & Milliken, RCVD, GT3 slick). Front: (290+290)*9.81*12 = 68268. Rear: (395+381)*9.81*12 = 91343. Used as C_linear_ref when OLS cannot resolve the linear stiffness from data (insufficient alpha excitation on rear axle). Accuracy Level 1.

classification._comment: Corner-verdict thresholds for ui/views/outing_form.py's _classify_corner. Each entry's derived_from records the diagnostic run and estimator version it was picked against -- a threshold is only valid for the distribution it was derived from (CLAUDE.md deviation taxonomy: classification thresholds differ from the chair BY RULE, always re-derived per estimator/car).
